title: Energy field operations permit bundle
description: Field service intake, drilling and production evidence, permit gates, and an energy ontology sliver.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: energy-field-operations
  title: Energy field operations permit bundle
  description: Field service intake, drilling and production evidence, permit gates, and an energy ontology sliver.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-well-03
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/energy
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs:
        - well.well_name
        - operator.operator_name
        - field_service_job.ticket_number
        - field_service_job.job_type
        - field_service_job.job_description
        - field_service_job.service_date
        - field_service_job.approval_status
      relationshipIds: [operated_by, performed_at]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/energy/field_ticket, role: start }
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/energy/daily_drilling_report, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/energy/production_report, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/energy/well_completion_report, role: supporting }
  bindings:
    - id: job-description-to-work-request
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/energy/field_ticket, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/1/fields/2 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-well-03, path: /spec/nodes/0/inputSchema/properties/workflowFields/properties/work_request }
      ontologyPropertyRef: field_service_job.job_description
      direction: input
    - id: job-type-to-active-operations
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/energy/field_ticket, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/1/fields/1 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-well-03, path: /spec/nodes/0/inputSchema/properties/workflowFields/properties/active_operations }
      ontologyPropertyRef: field_service_job.job_type
      direction: input
    - id: well-to-permit-preparation
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/energy/field_ticket, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/4/fields/2 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-well-03, path: /spec/nodes/2/prompt }
      ontologyPropertyRef: well.well_name
      direction: review
    - id: approval-status-to-authority-gate
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/energy/field_ticket, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/6/fields/0 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-well-03, path: /spec/nodes/8/summary }
      ontologyPropertyRef: field_service_job.approval_status
      direction: approval
